title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Standing Instruction. Keep it, take the blotter pick, or take the category standard. This roll ran degraded: no catalog challengers.

options.label: Standing Instruction
options.lineage: CAMS / Zerodha SIP mandate and NACH debit forms
options.thesis: Every buy is a filled-in debit instruction: scheme, amount, frequency, wallet as signatory.
options.viewport: No hero. A full-width instruction sheet: left, live names as a scheme schedule; right, a debit ticket already filled with MAG7 and 100 USDC.
options.risk: Can look like a government PDF if the rules go thick and the type goes timid.

raised.raise: Basket weights read as an allotment table, not chips.
The debit ticket stays docked while the schedule scrolls.

options.label: Broker Blotter
options.lineage: Interactive Brokers order ticket beside a watchlist
options.thesis: Markets as a blotter: rows you scan, a ticket you fill, never a card grid.
options.viewport: Dense name list with last/chg/sentiment; a persistent buy ticket for the selected basket on the right.
options.risk: Also the direction most brokerage redesigns land on — familiar, maybe too familiar.

canonCard.label: Dark crypto dashboard
canonCard.thesis: Navy glass, blue glow, identical stock cards — the category default, executed well.
canonCard.viewport: Gradient hero, four stock cards, Connect Wallet.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other Solana dApp by design.
